dct_description_sm: Guide defines Prime Farmland, Unique Farmland, Additional Farmland of Statewide Importance, Additional Farmland of Local Importance and lists the soil mapping units for Prime Farmland and Additional Farmland of Statewide Importance.

Shows "prime farmland", "additional farmland of statewide importance" and "other land."; "Base Source: USGS 1:100,000 county base compiled in 1977 ..."; "Interpretations derived from soil map constructed in 1971 by Cartographic Division, Soil Conservation Service, USDA, of Fayette County, Pennsylvania."; "December 1981."; Includes location map and note.
1 map :color ;98 x 126 cm + guide (6 unnumbered pages ; 28 cm).
